brief:
An Israeli television channel outlined structural details of a prospective government led by Gadi Eisenkot designed to remove Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu from power, Shehab Wire reported. The plan emerged amid competition for key cabinet positions and signals of external Arab support for securing parliamentary confidence.

The proposal reflects ongoing political maneuvering within Israel's coalition negotiations as various factions seek to reshape the government's composition and leadership structure.

title: Israeli TV outlines Eisenkot government plan to oust Netanyahu
